description: Given an integer n with n >= 2, determine whether n is prime. Return true if no integer k with 2 <= k < n divides n, and false if some integer k with 2 <= k < n divides n.
notes: The Dafny spec states VERINA's check over the range 2..n-1 with the recursive predicate NoDivisorFrom(n, 2) instead of a forall/exists pair: it means the same thing, and unlike the existential form Dafny can decide it on concrete inputs (the probes for non-prime n need a witness divisor otherwise).
